metric_definitions.gold_token_share: tokens of packed items overlapping a gold range / tokens used (labeled precision; 0 when empty)
metric_definitions.packing_loss: gold planned but not packed complete
metric_definitions.required_file_recall: gold whose file has any packed item
metric_definitions.required_symbol_header_only: gold only partly shown (header view or partial overlap)
metric_definitions.required_symbol_recall: gold whose whole source range lies inside one packed item / mapped gold
metric_definitions.routed_gold_coverage: gold among CandidateGraph nodes (the selection ceiling)
metric_definitions.tokens: oxide-units-v1, the canonical payload unit; not any model's tokenizer
metric_definitions.unlabeled_token_share: 1 - gold_token_share: an upper bound on noise; there are no irrelevance labels, so true noise is not measured

phase3_baseline: docs/phase-3/baseline-v1 (same snapshot, retrieval and routing configuration)
